description.en: Filters the results by one or more application names.

description.zh: 按展示名进行模糊搜索的关键字
description.en: The keyword for a fuzzy search on display names.

description.zh: 键集分页 token，获取第一页数据时无需传入，否则需要传入前一页查询结果中的 nextToken 字段
description.en: The next token for keyset pagination. Omit this parameter for the first page. For subsequent pages, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response.

description.zh: 分页排序属性，决定根据何种属性进行记录排序；推荐在实现严格遍历时，使用 id 属性
description.en: The sort property. To ensure consistent traversal, we recommend setting this to `id`.
Filters the results by one or more owner IDs.

description.zh: 页面分页时使用，用于获取下一页内容
description.en: The page number to retrieve. This parameter is used for page-based pagination.

description.zh: 分页模式参数，目前只支持键集分页 keyset 模式
description.en: The pagination mode. Currently, only keyset pagination is supported.

description.zh: 分页尺寸参数，决定一页最多返回多少对象
description.en: The maximum number of items to return per page.

description.zh: 分页排序升降序，asc 为升序，desc 为降序；推荐在实现严格遍历时，使用升序
description.en: The sort order. For consistent traversal, we recommend using ascending order.
Filters the results by one or more states.
